notes:
User is planning a dinner party this weekend. Planned menu so far:
- Main: Lemon Garlic Chicken Breast with Roasted Vegetables
- Side: Simple roasted vegetable medley using a colorful mix such as broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, Brussels sprouts, peppers, squash/zucchini, tomatoes, or asparagus; roast at 425°F (220°C) for about 20–25 minutes.
- Side: Crispy roasted sweet potatoes. Tips: choose starchy Russet/Idaho-style sweet potatoes, cut evenly, pat dry, toss with high-smoke-point oil and seasoning, roast at 425°F, avoid overcrowding, and turn halfway through.
- Side: Cauliflower gnocchi with Brown Butter Sage Sauce (butter, sage, optional garlic, salt/pepper, and Parmesan). User is excited to try it and previously promised to report the result.

User also enjoys experimenting with practical recipes and cooking tips. They bought Trader Joe’s cauliflower gnocchi and considered tomato sauce, pesto cream, roasted vegetables, sausage and peppers, mushroom sauce, spinach, and breakfast-style preparations, but chose brown butter sage sauce. Useful preparation details: cook gnocchi in salted water according to package directions until floating; reserve pasta water; brown 4 tbsp butter for about 5–7 minutes without burning, add sage 1–2 minutes, season, toss with gnocchi, and loosen with pasta water if needed.

User recently enjoys a grocery-list app, though its name remains unknown, and had successfully persuaded their mom to use it as well. They now share lists to coordinate shopping. Mom previously used a paper list.

Most recently, user planned chicken fajitas for dinner and needed onions, bell peppers, and olive oil. They also wanted fresh cilantro and parsley. Storage advice can emphasize lightly damp paper towel in an airtight container/container in the refrigerator, or stems in water covered loosely with a bag; change water regularly. For longer storage, chop and freeze herbs.

User ended the fajita-cooking exchange happily and is all set. Future assistance should remain friendly and practical, without claiming personal experience or preferences as an AI.
